title: GM Nightfall Solar Sunbracers Warlock
key_aspects_fragments: Touch of Flame, Heat Rises, Ember of Empyrean, Ember of Torches, Solar Siphon
notes: Powered melee kill grants unlimited solar grenades. Continuous solar kills extend Restoration and Radiant timers indefinitely.

title: Prismatic Consecration Slam Titan
key_aspects_fragments: Consecration, Knockout, Facet of Ruin, Facet of Courage, Heavy Handed
notes: Slide-melee sends devastating triple solar waves resulting in room-clearing ignitions while Synthoceps maximizes slam damage.

title: Endgame Void Invisibility Hunter
key_aspects_fragments: Stylish Executioner, Vanishing Step, Echo of Starvation, Echo of Persistence
notes: Permanent invisibility loop. Defeating volatile targets grants invisibility and full health via Devour; breaking invisibility grants Volatile Rounds.

title: Solar Hunter Blade Barrage Boss DPS (Shards of Galanor)
kinetic_weapon: User's choice (Sniper or Kinetic Tremors scout recommended)
heavy_weapon: One Thousand Voices (Recommended if unlocked; Apex Predator or Dragon's Breath are alternatives, just not as good)
key_aspects_fragments: Knock 'Em Down, Crackshot | Ember of Benevolence, Ember of Empyrean, Ember of Singeing, Ember of Ashes
notes:
Activity: Dungeon / Raid // Focus: Boss DPS
Artifact: Tablet of Ruin (Limit Break, Elemental Supercharger, Particle Reconstruction (for One Thousand Voices to apply weakening))
Armor Set: Lustrous Casque Set (Tower Kiosk / Solstice Armor Engrams) (4-Piece Set Bonus: Heals on Solar weapon final blows.)
Mods: Helmet: 2x Dynamo, 1x Harmonic Siphon; Arms: Dexterity Mod (matching weapon choice), 1x Harmonic Loader; Legs: 2x Solar Weapon Surge, 1x Holster Mod (user's choice); Class: Powerful Attraction, Distribution, Reaper
Stats: 150+ Weapon & Super stat (200 is best), at least 100 Class stat, 0 Health, low Melee and Grenade (not a key part of the build).
Ghost Mod: Powerhouse (Recommended to get close to target stat splits)

title: Arc Warlock Chaos Reach Infinite Super & Ad Clear (Geomag Stabilizers)
energy_weapon: Arc weapon with Jolting Feedback & Voltshot (e.g. Chrysura Melo from 'The Shattered Throne' dungeon - easiest dungeon in the game)
heavy_weapon: One Thousand Voices or Thunderlord (Thunderlord is very easy to get and still very, very good)
key_aspects_fragments: Arc Soul, Electrostatic Mind | Spark of Resistance, Spark of Frequency, Spark of Discharge, Spark of Shock
notes:
Activity: Dungeon / Raid // Focus: Boss DPS, Soft Ad Clear
Artifact: Tablet of Ruin (especially if using 1K or fusion alongside) (Dielectric, Flashover, Photonic Flare, Limit Break, Defibrillating Blast)
Armor Set: Luminopotent Set (Fireteam Ops or focus from Zavala) (4-Piece Set Bonus: 'Shock and Clear' — Final blows with Jolt or against Jolted combatants create Ionic Traces which fund your Super.)
Mods: Helmet: 1x Harmonic Siphon, 2x Font of Wisdom (Super Fonts); Arms: 2x Font of Discipline (Grenade Fonts), 1x Bolstering Detonation; Legs: 1x Arc Weapon Surge, 1x Better Already, 1x Recuperation; Class: 1x Reaper, 1x Powerful Attraction, 1x Time Dilation
Stats: 150+ Grenade and Super stats, 50+ Class and Weapons, 0 Health and Melee are not really used (unless you find yourself doing more melee than grenades).
Ghost Mod: Grenadier, Powerhouse, or Demolitionist (Recommended for these stats)

title: Stasis Titan Unkillable Glacial Guard & Frost Armor (Icefall Mantle)
kinetic_weapon: Fighting Lion (Top Tier alternative which goes in the Primary/Kinetic slot)
energy_weapon: Icebreaker (Recommended if unlocked, found in 'Vesper's Host' Dungeon)
heavy_weapon: User's choice depending on whether using Icebreaker or Fighting Lion
key_aspects_fragments: Howl of the Storm, Tectonic Harvest | Whisper of Hunger, Whisper of Shards, Whisper of Conduction, Whisper of Rime
notes:
Activity: Grandmaster+ // Focus: Survivability, Survavability
Artifact: Slayer Baron Apothecary Satchel (Crystalline Converter, Wind Chill, Frost Renewal, Curative Orbs, Hail the Storm, The Thick of It, Brain Freeze)
Armor Set: Seventh Seraph Set (Cosmodrome Public Events / Master Lost Sectors for easy T5) OR Exodus Down Set (Nessus Public Events / Master Lost Sectors for easy T5) (High Tier-5 armor set providing maximum stat allocation and resilience thresholds.)
Mods: Helmet: 2x Hands-On, 1x Harmonic Siphon; Arms: 1x Impact Induction, 1x Grenade Kickstart, 1x Heavy Handed; Legs: 2x Invigoration, 1x Solar Weapon Surge (or Kinetic Surge if using Fighting Lion); Class: 1x Reaper, 1x Powerful Attraction, 1x Time Dilation
Stats: 100+ Weapon, Super, and Melee stat. Health, Grenade, and Class are user's choice (those stats don't really matter for this loop).
Ghost Mod: Skirmisher, Powerhouse, or Paragon (Recommended for achieving these stats)
